articles.title: Iraq turns to trucks to export oil in overland Syrian route revival
articles.description: Iraq has revived an overland oil export route through Syria to bypass disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz caused by the Iran war. Qatari energy group UCC Holding has been transporting 120,000-150,000 barrels per day of Iraqi crude by tanker trucks from southern Iraq to Syrias Mediterranean port of Baniyas since October 26.

articles.title: US military downs 2 Iranian attack drones as Iran claims a strike on a US radar in Bahrain
articles.description: The U.S. military has intercepted two Iranian attack drones headed toward Bahrain. Iran's Revolutionary Guard claimed it struck a U.S. radar system in Bahrain, but this couldn't be independently verified. The U.S. denied any damage or injuries. Iran also reported a tanker struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz, causing an explosion. Meanwhile, in Iran, thousands mourned 350 unidentified soldiers from the Iran-Iraq war. In Gaza, a 9-month-old boy died from hypothermia, raising concerns about the winter ahead. And Iran told the United Nations’ nuclear watchdog that discussions on nuclear monitoring cannot proceed while the country is facing military threats.
